title: Union Find
subtitle: Maintain a partition that only merges: representatives answer connectivity while root metadata summarizes each component.
variables: N = number of initialized elements, E = input edges, Q = queries, M = total DSU operations, α = inverse Ackermann function, A = number of accounts, H = email occurrences, U = unique emails, R*C = grid positions; L = output/query text length; U_g = distinct emails in output group g; E_lifetimes = number of active edge intervals in offline mixed-update problems. With union by size/rank plus path compression, M operations cost O(N+M α(N)) amortized total after initialization; a single operation is not guaranteed O(1). Weighted/rollback variants have explicitly different bounds. Dictionary-backed labels use expected hashing; hashing and comparing a long string costs O(length) initially/worst-case, and sorting strings adds comparison cost. Main bounds use fixed-width numeric arithmetic; Python large integers have additional bit complexity. Space separates initialized DSU arrays, constructed/sorted input copies, auxiliary stacks and returned output. Templates use standard-library Python 3.10+, integer IDs 0..N-1 unless explicitly mapped; root identifiers are unstable implementation details.
